Command:
```sh
python3 -c 'import json,collections; d=json.load(open("tools/registry.json", encoding="utf-8")); rows=d["rows"]; counts=collections.Counter(r["name"] for r in rows); duplicates={name:count for name,count in sorted(counts.items()) if count>1}; print(json.dumps({"active":sum(r.get("status")=="active" for r in rows),"superseded":sum(r.get("status")=="superseded" for r in rows),"duplicate_name_groups":len(duplicates),"duplicate_name_rows":sum(duplicates.values()),"duplicate_names":duplicates},sort_keys=True))'
